Black Hole's Time-Bending Veil

Witnessing a fall into a black hole isn't what you'd expect. Due to extreme physics, you'd never actually see them cross the event horizon. Instead, they'd appear to freeze, fade, and vanish as their light stretches infinitely. 🤯 How does this cosmic illusion challenge our understanding of reality?
